title: Remove archived reader receipt duplicates from active records

intent.problem: The previous reader-validation Work Item is archived and its handoff and receipt are preserved in the immutable archive event record, but duplicate JSON files remain under active/ and block creation of the next Work Item.
constraints: Do not alter the archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, Manifest, or event bytes.
Do not alter reader answers, timestamps, bindings, or the comprehension result.
Remove only the two verified active duplicates and retain archive-backed evidence.
intent.rationale: Restore the lifecycle invariant that active/ contains no records for a closed Work Item before starting the next governed Work Item.

outOfScope: Other scripts and tests outside the backtrack authorization seam.

sources.reason: Contains the exact handoff and ingested receipt evidence retained after closure.
Binds the immutable archived Work Item evidence.
Defines orphan active receipt and no-active lifecycle behavior.
Enforces active Work Item and lifecycle consistency before starting the next item.
Current backtrack guard incorrectly blocks explicitly authorized Work Item evidence cleanup.
Regression surface for authorization-aware evidence-removal detection.
Pre-archive changed-critical coverage currently reads v2 baselineDirtyPaths with the wrong value shape.
Regression surface for v2 baselineDirtyPaths object records in pre-archive coverage.
Authoritative changed-critical test mapping for the backtrack guard regression.

problemStatement: Remove only active duplicate receipt records whose exact evidence is already preserved in the archived event log, so the next Work Item can start without weakening lifecycle guards.
rawUserRequest: Reopen the governed work sequence, but complete the previous Work Item's cleanup before starting the next one.

declaredIntent.summary: Clean only orphan active receipt duplicates left by the closed reader-validation Work Item before the next Work Item starts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Both archived duplicate files are removed from active
Archived event evidence remains unchanged and readable

scenarioCoverage.reason: The next Work Item cannot be started until this cleanup is merged and closed; its start-state check is outside this Work Item's verification boundary.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Backtrack regression proves an approved Summary/Contract deletion is accepted while an unapproved deletion remains blocking.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused regression proves object records are normalized to paths without weakening scope ownership checks.

riskAssessment.reason: The cleanup removes duplicate active records and adjusts the backtrack guard so only Contract-authorized, Summary-recorded Work Item evidence removal is accepted; immutable archive evidence remains out of scope.

reasons: Lifecycle-only cleanup with strict archive preservation.

executionDecision.reason: The exact duplicates and their archive-backed evidence are identified.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm no archive bytes are changed.

acceptance: The two closed Work Item receipt duplicates no longer exist under active/.

No documentation, implementation, release, or historical archive claim is changed.
